info.name: Kanmon Public V2 Bank Accounts Invoices API

params.name: id
params.description: Either the Kanmon invoice UUID or your platform’s invoice ID, depending on `idType`.

params.name: idType
params.description: Which ID type to query the invoice by. Defaults to `KANMON`. Use `PLATFORM` if you want to query by your platform’s ID.

params.name: statuses
params.description: A comma delimited list of invoice statuses.

params.name: ids
params.description: A comma delimited list of Kanmon’s unique IDs for invoices.

params.name: platformBusinessIds
params.description: A comma delimited list of your platform’s unique IDs for businesses.

params.name: businessIds
params.description: A comma delimited list of Kanmon’s unique IDs for businesses.

params.name: platformInvoiceIds
params.description: A comma delimited list of your platforms’s unique IDs for invoices.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of records to skip when performing pagination. Defaults to `0`.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of records to limit when performing pagination. Defaults to `100`, which is the max.

params.name: createdAtStart
params.description: Filter for records where `createdAt` is greater than or equal to this value. ISO 8601 format.

params.name: createdAtEnd
params.description: Filter for records where `createdAt` is less than or equal to this value. ISO 8601 format.

items.docs: Finance an invoice for an issued product directly instead of using the embedded UI. `payeeType` is required for `ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE_FINANCING`, `payorType` for `INVOICE_FINANCING`. Extra payee/payor fields are optional.
